text:
sec-bot: [SECURITY NOTICE] Detected a zero-day in libproxy-httpx v3.8.0 (CVE-2024-XXXX). Vulnerability: header parsing leading to request-smuggling and potential inbound request injection or crash. Affects Dedicated and Private runtime images built before 2024-07-01. Immediate required actions:

sec-bot: 1) Patch runtime images to libproxy-httpx v3.8.1+ and push new runtime tags.
sec-bot: 2) Rotate long-lived self-hosted connector/service-account keys created before 2024-07-01.
sec-bot: 3) Apply temporary WAF/header-normalization rule for incoming edge traffic.
sec-bot: Runbook & checklist: https://redwood.internal/sec/runbooks/libhttpx-3-8-0 (internal)

marta: Is Hosted API impacted or only Dedicated/Private?

oliver: Hosted API runs on our managed fleet that already pulled the patched base image this morning — hosted NOT affected. Dedicated clusters and customer Private images that built from our old base are at risk. I'll enumerate clusters and images now.

ashley: Quick detection commands you can run on clusters/private infra:
```
# list images containing the libhttpx base
kubectl get pods -A -o go-template='{{range .items}}{{.metadata.namespace}} {{.spec.containers[*].image}}\n{{end}}' | grep libproxy-httpx || true
# find docker images on hosts
ssh host "docker images | grep libproxy-httpx || true"
```

marta: We also need to rotate self-hosted connector keys (long-lived tokens). Ops, please prioritize connectors that authenticate to customer VPCs or on-prem. @ops-bot can you schedule?

ops-bot: Scheduled automation job created: rotate-connector-secrets-171235 for us-west-2, eu-west-1. Start window: 2024-04-05T02:00Z. Job details: internal runbook ID rotate-171235. Will report per-region completion.

jonah: Oncall plan: 2-hour incident sprints. Leads: @ashley (lead), @oliver (platform), @marta (sec verification). Post updates every 30m in this thread. Escalate to @vp-security if we hit customer-impact.

emily: I'll update the status page once we confirm no Hosted impact.

sec-bot: Patch build notes: build runtime tag with upgraded libproxy-httpx 3.8.1. Example build/push steps:
```
docker build -t registry.redwood.ai/runtime:3.8.1 .
docker push registry.redwood.ai/runtime:3.8.1
# CI patch job: .circleci/patch-httpx.yml triggers image promotion
```

ashley: I've queued builds for dedicated pools: redwood-dedicated-a, -b, -c. Starting rolling update now. Rolling strategy: maxUnavailable=1, staggered per-region. Monitor with:
```
kubectl -n <ns> rollout status deploy/inference
kubectl -n <ns> get pods -l app=inference -o wide
```

ops-bot: Rotation progress: connectors in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 rotated and old keys revoked. Remaining regions: ap-southeast-1, sa-east-1.

marta: Legal and CS: please prepare an advisory draft for Dedicated customers. Wait to send until we hit ~80% cluster patching or if we detect customer-visible issues.

oliver: Agreed. We'll hold outbound customer comms until 80% patched; internal heads-up to affected accounts team in parallel.

sec-bot: For Private/on-prem customers: they must rebuild base image with libproxy-httpx 3.8.1 and restart inference services within 24 hours of this notice. If you manage Private installs for a customer, coordinate with their infra lead immediately.

emily: Current patch status: 45% of Dedicated clusters updated. Next status in 30m.

ops-bot: Final note: if you see any anomalous 4xx/5xx spikes or header-parsing errors in the logs, add tag "libhttpx-incident" and escalate to #incidents. Use this quick grep:
```
journalctl -u inference | grep -iE "header parse|request smuggle|httpx" || true
```

ashley: First region (us-west-2) roll completed, smoke tests passed. K8s rollout stable. Patching -b now.

ops-bot: Rotation complete for connectors in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. All old keys revoked and new keys distributed to connector service accounts.

marta: Thanks team. Keep updates short and frequent. I'll assemble post-incident notes after we reach stable state.

emily: Status update: 100% of affected Dedicated clusters patched at 1712360400. Closing actionable work; followups: customer advisory draft, postmortem, and update to private deploy docs.

sec-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> move to monitoring. Postmortem owner: marta. Timeline & artifacts: https://redwood.internal/sec/incidents/libhttpx-171235 (internal)
